title: 1821. Game Character System using Virtual Functions
description:
using Virtual Functions
40
Medium
Game Character System using Virtual Functions
Problem Statement:
Design a game character hierarchy demonstrating dynamic binding.
Description:
Base Class: Character
Virtual function attack()
Derived Classes:
1. Warrior
2. Mage
3. Archer
Requirements:
1. Use base class pointer.
2. Call attack() dynamically.
3. Add virtual destructor.
4. Show output difference based on actual object.
5. Demonstrate polymorphic behavior in loop.
Input Format:
Character Type
Output Format:
Character Attack Message
Sample Input:
Mage
Sample Output:
Mage casts Fireball!
